rationale: Crimean Bridge attack continues pattern of strikes on Black Sea infrastructure critical to regional security; underground tunnel warfare in Kharkiv shows conflict intensification near Romania's northern neighbor.

top_events.title: Crimean Bridge attacked again, Russian official says
